title: NASA Mars Trek WMTS Planetary Cartography Service
notes: Primary equirectangular tile service for Viking Color, MOLA Hillshade, and MOC Atlas mosaics.

title: NASA Open APIs Portal
notes: NASA centralized API gateway for Mars imagery, telemetry, and cartography.

title: Subsurface Water Ice Mapping (SWIM) on Mars — Planetary Science Institute
notes: Multispectral radar, thermal, and neutron shallow water ice likelihood mapping in mid-latitudes.

title: NASA Phoenix Mars Lander — In-Situ Water Ice Discovery
notes: Direct physical exposure of pure subsurface water ice by robotic trenching at Green Valley (68.2°N).

title: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance — MEDA Weather Station
notes: Direct surface air and ground temperature measurements in Jezero Crater (-83°C pre-dawn to +5°C noon).

title: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance — MOXIE Atmospheric O2 Extraction
notes: Solid oxide electrolysis extracting 122g of breathable oxygen from ambient Martian CO2.

title: NASA PDS Geosciences Node — MSL Curiosity PLACES Traverse Dataset
notes: Ground-truth rover positioning and drive logs in Gale Crater.

title: USGS & NASA HiRISE Study: Recurring Slope Lineae as Dry Granular Sand Flows
notes: Analysis of 151 features proving RSL terminate at dry repose angles (>27°) and are not flowing liquid aquifers.

title: NASA GISS Mars24 Sunclock Time & Ephemeris Algorithm
notes: Allison & McEwen (2000) areocentric solar longitude (Ls) and LTST diurnal calculation formulas.

title: NASA Eyes on the Solar System — Mars 3D
notes: Real-time 3D planetary orbital context and spacecraft trajectory visualization.

title: NASA Image and Video Library API
notes: Dynamic retrieval of archival imagery and scientific observations by location name.

title: HiRISE Planetary Camera Operations — University of Arizona
notes: Sub-meter high-resolution orbital reconnaissance imagery of Mars surface features.
